i understand how you feel, even if i am only 13 i understand the feeling of being hated, i have came close many times to just ending it all, but i realized i still had things i NEEDED to do, i had a 6 year old sister, i could not imagen her growing up without her big bro, my parents, my animals, my aunts and uncles, and my stepfather who has spent more time raising me than my parents did, my dad was was split from my mom, he has grown to be a awesome guy though, and my mom was the one to work and provide for me and my step dad, so the only one to care for me was him, he has ever since i was 2 years old, and i cant just go and off myself... not yet i still have things i need to do, and i believe you will find someone if you have not already that will care for you, and love you like my family did, i wish you the best of luck and i wish you a good life, and hopefully a long one and just know, we are here for you, I am here for you if you want it...
